identification: Two rough-sawn live-edge slabs, pale yellow, straight grain, knots and bark edges, about 2 m+ long and 30 to 45 cm wide, chalked 1117 23/10/26. Catalogued Huon pine (Gowans lots are routinely sold under this title, many look like celery-top or similar pale timber). Species not confirmable from photo. Photo is one shot of a row of slabs; only the two marked 1117 belong to the lot.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) on huon pine slab, huon pine; Gowans API search 2 slabs of huon pine and slab huon pine (pages 1-2); WebSearch huon pine slab price Tasmania (retail asking only). Not searched: armitage site, eBay (closed). Typical Gowans 2 SLABS lots 2025-26: about 900 sold, median hammer $55, mostly $30 to $100, rare outliers $140-$220 for better or wider boards. Last week (11 Oct 2026) the 2 SLABS lots ranged $50 to $105 hammer, median about $65. Buyer's premium 19.8% extra. No FX needed (AUD).
viewing_check: Check species: Huon pine has a distinct sweet smell when scratched, very fine even grain, and a pale yellow tone; look at the end grain and chalk-scratch a spot. Check width, length and thickness of the two marked 1117, and for splits, rot at the ends and borer. Wide, clean, birdseye or figured slabs are the ones that go above $100.
